domain_focus: Dense lexical causal-context relation extraction for normalized CausalBank grounded by WordNet Full.
abstraction_level: benchmark endpoint identity and record-level causal-relation family first; shallow ontology construction
population_policy: Maximize coverage of the normalized dense lexical causal-context graph. Derive lexical/stem nodes only from visible document tokens; for a known visible record family, connect every ordered non-self pair using BECAUSE or THEREFORE. No pair-level LLM pruning and no gold access.
event_modeling_preference: Represent endpoints as canonical lexical/stem nodes, not proposition spans.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
